290:   y = db_clamp(y, 0, state->vinfo.yres);
291:   if (x >= right || y >= bottom)
292:     {
293:       return;
294:     }
295: 
296:   area.x = x;
297:   area.y = y;
298:   area.w = right - x;
299:   area.h = bottom - y;
300: 
301:   if (ioctl(state->fbfd, FBIO_UPDATE,
302:             (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)&area) < 0 && !state->updateerror)
303:     {
304:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: FBIO_UPDATE failed: %d\n", errno);
305:       state->updateerror = true;
306:     }
307: #else
308:   (void)state;
309:   (void)x;
310:   (void)y;
311:   (void)width;
312:   (void)height;
313: #endif
314: }

316: static void db_disk(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int centerx, int centery,
317:                     int radius, uint16_t color, int cliptop)
318: {
319:   int radiussquared = radius * radius;
320:   int y;
321: 
322:   for (y = -radius; y <= radius; y++)
323:     {
324:       int yy = centery + y;
325:       int x;
326: 
327:       if (yy < cliptop || yy >= state->vinfo.yres)
328:         {
329:           continue;
330:         }
331: 
332:       for (x = -radius; x <= radius; x++)
333:         {
334:           int xx = centerx + x;
335: 
336:           if (x * x + y * y <= radiussquared && xx >= 0 &&
337:               xx < state->vinfo.xres)
338:             {
339:               db_row(state, yy)[xx] = color;
340:             }
341:         }
342:     }
343: }
344: 
345: static void db_line(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int x0, int y0,
346:                     int x1, int y1, int radius, uint16_t color,
347:                     int cliptop)
348: {
349:   int dx = db_abs(x1 - x0);
350:   int dy = db_abs(y1 - y0);
351:   int steps = db_max(dx, dy);
352:   int spacing = db_max(radius / 2, 1);
353:   int step;
354: 
355:   if (steps == 0)
356:     {
357:       db_disk(state, x1, y1, radius, color, cliptop);
358:       return;
359:     }
360: 
361:   for (step = 0; step < steps; step += spacing)
362:     {
363:       int x = x0 + (int)((int64_t)(x1 - x0) * step / steps);
364:       int y = y0 + (int)((int64_t)(y1 - y0) * step / steps);
365: 
366:       db_disk(state, x, y, radius, color, cliptop);
367:     }
368: 
369:   db_disk(state, x1, y1, radius, color, cliptop);
370: }

375:     {
376:       case 'A':
377:         return g_glyph_a;
378:       case 'C':
379:         return g_glyph_c;
380:       case 'E':
381:         return g_glyph_e;
382:       case 'I':

384:       case 'L':
385:         return g_glyph_l;
386:       case 'M':
387:         return g_glyph_m;
388:       case 'R':
389:         return g_glyph_r;
390:       case 'S':
391:         return g_glyph_s;
392:       case 'T':

394:       case 'X':

397:         return NULL;

401: static void db_text(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int centerx, int y,
402:                     FAR const char *text, int scale, uint16_t color)
403: {
404:   int length = strlen(text);
405:   int x = centerx - (length * 6 - 1) * scale / 2;
406: 
407:   while (*text != '\0')
408:     {
409:       FAR const uint8_t *glyph = db_glyph(*text++);
410:       int column;
411: 
412:       if (glyph != NULL)
413:         {
414:           for (column = 0; column < 5; column++)
415:             {
416:               int row;
417: 
418:               for (row = 0; row < 7; row++)
419:                 {
420:                   if ((glyph[column] & (1 << row)) != 0)
421:                     {
422:                       db_rectangle(state, x + column * scale,
423:                                    y + row * scale, scale, scale, color);
424:                     }
425:                 }
426:             }
427:         }
428: 
429:       x += 6 * scale;
430:     }
431: }

441: static void db_draw_color_button(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int index)
442: {

444:   int right = (index + 1) * state->vinfo.xres / DB_NCOLORS;
445:   int centerx = (left + right) / 2;
446:   int radius = db_min(right - left, state->rowheight) / 3;

448:   if (!state->eraser && state->colorindex == index)
449:     {

451:               DB_SELECTED, 0);
452:       db_disk(state, centerx, state->rowheight / 2, radius + 3,
453:               DB_TOOLBAR, 0);
454:     }
455: 
456:   db_disk(state, centerx, state->rowheight / 2, radius,
457:           g_colors[index], 0);
458: 
459:   if (index == 0)
460:     {
461:       db_frame(state, centerx - radius, state->rowheight / 2 - radius,
462:                2 * radius + 1, 2 * radius + 1, 1, DB_BORDER);
463:     }

466: static void db_draw_action_button(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int index)
467: {
468:   int top = state->rowheight;
469:   int left = index * state->vinfo.xres / DB_NACTIONS;
470:   int right = (index + 1) * state->vinfo.xres / DB_NACTIONS;
471:   int centerx = (left + right) / 2;
472:   int centery = top + state->rowheight / 3;
473:   int iconradius = db_min(state->rowheight / 5, (right - left) / 5);
474:   int scale = db_clamp(state->rowheight / 32, 1, 3);
475:   int labely = top + state->rowheight * 2 / 3;
476:   bool selected = false;
477: 
478:   if (index <= DB_ACTION_LARGE)
479:     {
480:       FAR const char *label;
481:       int radius;
482:       int preview;
483: 
484:       if (index == DB_ACTION_SMALL)
485:         {
486:           radius = CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_SMALL_RADIUS;
487:           label = "S";
488:         }
489:       else if (index == DB_ACTION_MEDIUM)
490:         {
491:           radius = CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_MEDIUM_RADIUS;
492:           label = "M";
493:         }
494:       else
495:         {
496:           radius = CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_LARGE_RADIUS;
497:           label = "L";
498:         }
499: 
500:       preview = db_clamp(radius, 3, iconradius);
501: 
502:       selected = !state->eraser && state->sizeindex == index;
503:       db_disk(state, centerx, centery, preview, state->color, top);
504:       db_text(state, centerx, labely, label, scale, DB_LABEL);
505:     }
506:   else if (index == DB_ACTION_ERASER)
507:     {
508:       selected = state->eraser;
509:       db_disk(state, centerx, centery, iconradius + 2, DB_BORDER, top);
510:       db_disk(state, centerx, centery, iconradius, DB_BACKGROUND, top);
511:       db_text(state, centerx, labely, "ERASE", scale, DB_LABEL);
512:     }
513:   else if (index == DB_ACTION_CLEAR)
514:     {
515:       int offset = iconradius * 2 / 3;
516:       int thick = db_max(iconradius / 4, 2);
517: 
518:       db_line(state, centerx - offset, centery - offset,
519:               centerx + offset, centery + offset, thick, DB_EXIT, top);
520:       db_line(state, centerx + offset, centery - offset,
521:               centerx - offset, centery + offset, thick, DB_EXIT, top);
522:       db_text(state, centerx, labely, "CLEAR", scale, DB_LABEL);
523:     }
524:   else
525:     {
526:       int thick = db_max(iconradius / 4, 2);
527: 
528:       db_disk(state, centerx, centery, iconradius, DB_EXIT, top);
529:       db_rectangle(state, centerx - thick / 2,
530:                    centery - iconradius - thick,
531:                    thick, iconradius + thick + 1, DB_TOOLBAR);
532:       db_text(state, centerx, labely, "EXIT", scale, DB_LABEL);
533:     }
534: 
535:   if (selected)
536:     {
537:       db_frame(state, left + 4, top + 4, right - left - 8,
538:                state->rowheight - 8, 4, DB_SELECTED);
539:     }
540: }

620: static void db_transform(FAR struct db_state_s *state, int rawx, int rawy,
621:                          FAR int *x, FAR int *y)
622: {
623:   int sourcewidth = state->touchwidth;
624:   int sourceheight = state->touchheight;
625: 
626:   if (state->swapxy)
627:     {
628:       int temporary = rawx;
629: 
630:       rawx = rawy;
631:       rawy = temporary;
632:       temporary = sourcewidth;
633:       sourcewidth = sourceheight;
634:       sourceheight = temporary;
635:     }
636: 
637:   rawx = db_clamp(rawx, 0, sourcewidth - 1);
638:   rawy = db_clamp(rawy, 0, sourceheight - 1);
639:   *x = (int)((int64_t)rawx * (state->vinfo.xres - 1) /
640:              (sourcewidth - 1));
641:   *y = (int)((int64_t)rawy * (state->vinfo.yres - 1) /
642:              (sourceheight - 1));
643: 
644:   if (state->mirrorx)
645:     {
646:       *x = state->vinfo.xres - 1 - *x;
647:     }
648: 
649:   if (state->mirrory)
650:     {
651:       *y = state->vinfo.yres - 1 - *y;
652:     }
653: }

655: static void db_end_contact(FAR struct db_state_s *state)
656: {
657:   state->contact = false;
658:   state->toolbarcontact = false;
659:   state->uppending = false;
660:   state->lastvalid = false;
661: }

663: static void db_touch(FAR struct db_state_s *state,
664:                      FAR const struct touch_sample_s *sample)
665: {
666:   FAR const struct touch_point_s *point;
667:   uint64_t now;
668:   bool fresh;
669:   int x;
670:   int y;
671: 
672:   if (state->verbose)
673:     {
674:       if (sample->npoints < 1)
675:         {
676:           printf("drawboard: touch n=0\n");
677:         }
678:       else
679:         {
680:           printf("drawboard: touch n=%d flags=0x%02x raw=(%d,%d)\n",
681:                  sample->npoints, sample->point[0].flags,
682:                  sample->point[0].x, sample->point[0].y);
683:         }
684:     }
685: 
686:   if (sample->npoints < 1)
687:     {
688:       db_end_contact(state);
689:       return;
690:     }
691: 
692:   point = &sample->point[0];
693:   now = db_milliseconds();
694: 
695:   if ((point->flags & TOUCH_UP) != 0)
696:     {
697:       state->uppending = true;
698:       state->uptime = now;
699:       return;
700:     }
701: 
702:   if ((point->flags & TOUCH_POS_VALID) == 0)
703:     {
704:       return;
705:     }
706: 
707:   if (state->uppending)
708:     {
709:       if (now == 0 || state->uptime == 0 ||
710:           now - state->uptime > DB_UP_GRACE_MS)
711:         {
712:           db_end_contact(state);
713:         }
714: 
715:       state->uppending = false;
716:     }
717: 
718:   fresh = !state->contact;
719:   state->contact = true;
720:   db_transform(state, point->x, point->y, &x, &y);
721: 
722:   if (fresh)
723:     {
724:       state->toolbarcontact = y < state->toolbarheight;
725:     }
726: 
727:   if (state->toolbarcontact)
728:     {
729:       if (fresh)
730:         {
731:           db_toolbar_touch(state, x, y);
732:         }
733: 
734:       return;
735:     }
736: 
737:   if (y < state->toolbarheight)
738:     {
739:       state->lastvalid = false;
740:       return;
741:     }
742: 
743:   if (state->lastvalid)
744:     {
745:       int left = db_min(state->lastx, x) - state->brush;
746:       int top = db_min(state->lasty, y) - state->brush;
747:       int right = db_max(state->lastx, x) + state->brush + 1;
748:       int bottom = db_max(state->lasty, y) + state->brush + 1;
749: 
750:       db_line(state, state->lastx, state->lasty, x, y, state->brush,
751:               state->color, state->toolbarheight);
752:       db_update(state, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
753:     }
754:   else
755:     {
756:       db_disk(state, x, y, state->brush, state->color,
757:               state->toolbarheight);
758:       db_update(state, x - state->brush, y - state->brush,
759:                 state->brush * 2 + 1, state->brush * 2 + 1);
760:     }
761: 
762:   state->lastx = x;
763:   state->lasty = y;
764:   state->lastvalid = true;
765: }

767: static void db_usage(FAR const char *program)
768: {
769:   printf("Usage: %s [-f fbdev] [-t touchdev] [-x width] [-y height] "
770:          "[-sXYvP]\n", program);
771:   printf("  -f path   framebuffer device (default %s)\n",
772:          CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_FBDEV);
773:   printf("  -t path   touchscreen device (default %s)\n",
774:          CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_TOUCHDEV);
775:   printf("  -x width  raw touchscreen X range (default display width)\n");
776:   printf("  -y height raw touchscreen Y range (default display height)\n");
777:   printf("  -s        swap touchscreen X and Y\n");
778:   printf("  -X        mirror touchscreen X\n");
779:   printf("  -Y        mirror touchscreen Y\n");
780:   printf("  -v        print touchscreen events\n");
781:   printf("  -P        poll touchscreen if IRQ is unavailable\n");
782: }

784: static int db_open_framebuffer(FAR struct db_state_s *state,
785:                                FAR const char *path)
786: {
787:   size_t visible;
788: 
789:   state->fbfd = open(path, O_RDWR);
790:   if (state->fbfd < 0)
791:     {
792:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: open %s failed: %d\n", path, errno);
793:       return -errno;
794:     }
795: 
796:   if (ioctl(state->fbfd, FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO,
797:             (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)&state->vinfo) < 0)
798:     {
799:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO failed: %d\n", errno);
800:       return -errno;
801:     }
802: 
803:   memset(&state->pinfo, 0, sizeof(state->pinfo));
804:   if (ioctl(state->fbfd, FBIOGET_PLANEINFO,
805:             (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)&state->pinfo) < 0)
806:     {
807:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: FBIOGET_PLANEINFO failed: %d\n", errno);
808:       return -errno;
809:     }
810: 
811:   visible = (size_t)state->pinfo.stride * state->vinfo.yres;
812:   if (state->vinfo.fmt != FB_FMT_RGB16_565 || state->pinfo.bpp != 16 ||
813:       state->vinfo.nplanes < 1 ||
814:       state->pinfo.stride < state->vinfo.xres * sizeof(uint16_t) ||
815:       state->pinfo.fblen < visible)
816:     {
817:       fprintf(stderr,
818:               "drawboard: unsupported framebuffer fmt=%u bpp=%u "
819:               "planes=%u stride=%u size=%zu\n",
820:               state->vinfo.fmt, state->pinfo.bpp, state->vinfo.nplanes,
821:               state->pinfo.stride, state->pinfo.fblen);
822:       return -ENOTSUP;
823:     }
824: 
825:   state->fbmem = mmap(NULL, state->pinfo.fblen, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
826:                       MAP_SHARED | MAP_FILE, state->fbfd, 0);
827:   if (state->fbmem == MAP_FAILED)
828:     {
829:       state->fbmem = NULL;
830:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: mmap %s failed: %d\n", path, errno);
831:       return -errno;
832:     }
833: 
834:   return 0;
835: }

837: static void db_close(FAR struct db_state_s *state)
838: {
839:   if (state->touchfd >= 0)
840:     {
841:       close(state->touchfd);
842:     }
843: 
844:   if (state->fbmem != NULL)
845:     {
846:       munmap(state->fbmem, state->pinfo.fblen);
847:     }
848: 
849:   if (state->fbfd >= 0)
850:     {
851:       close(state->fbfd);
852:     }
853: }

859: int main(int argc, FAR char *argv[])
860: {
861:   FAR const char *fbpath = CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_FBDEV;
862:   FAR const char *touchpath = CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DRAWBOARD_TOUCHDEV;
863:   struct db_state_s state;
864:   int rawwidth = 0;
865:   int rawheight = 0;
866:   int option;
867:   int ret;
868: 
869:   memset(&state, 0, sizeof(state));
870:   state.fbfd = -1;
871:   state.touchfd = -1;
872: 
873:   while ((option = getopt(argc, argv, "f:t:x:y:sXYvPh")) != ERROR)
874:     {
875:       switch (option)
876:         {
877:           case 'f':
878:             fbpath = optarg;
879:             break;
880:           case 't':
881:             touchpath = optarg;
882:             break;
883:           case 'x':
884:             rawwidth = atoi(optarg);
885:             break;
886:           case 'y':
887:             rawheight = atoi(optarg);
888:             break;
889:           case 's':
890:             state.swapxy = true;
891:             break;
892:           case 'X':
893:             state.mirrorx = true;
894:             break;
895:           case 'Y':
896:             state.mirrory = true;
897:             break;
898:           case 'v':
899:             state.verbose = true;
900:             break;
901:           case 'P':
902:             state.polling = true;
903:             break;
904:           case 'h':
905:             db_usage(argv[0]);
906:             return EXIT_SUCCESS;
907:           default:
908:             db_usage(argv[0]);
909:             return EXIT_FAILURE;
910:         }
911:     }
912: 
913:   ret = db_open_framebuffer(&state, fbpath);
914:   if (ret < 0)
915:     {
916:       goto out;
917:     }
918: 
919:   state.touchwidth = rawwidth > 1 ? rawwidth : state.vinfo.xres;
920:   state.touchheight = rawheight > 1 ? rawheight : state.vinfo.yres;
921:   if (state.touchwidth < 2 || state.touchheight < 2)
922:     {
923:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: invalid touchscreen coordinate range\n");
924:       ret = -EINVAL;
925:       goto out;
926:     }
927: 
928:   state.touchfd = open(touchpath, O_RDONLY);
929:   if (state.touchfd < 0)
930:     {
931:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: open %s failed: %d\n", touchpath,
932:               errno);
933:       ret = -errno;
934:       goto out;
935:     }
936: 
937:   state.rowheight = db_clamp(state.vinfo.yres / 20,
938:                              DB_MIN_ROW_HEIGHT, DB_MAX_ROW_HEIGHT);
939:   state.toolbarheight = state.rowheight * 2;
940:   if (state.toolbarheight >= state.vinfo.yres)
941:     {
942:       fprintf(stderr, "drawboard: display is too short for the toolbar\n");
943:       ret = -ENOSPC;
944:       goto out;
945:     }
